# Timebox before you know

## The heuristic

**Commit to a stopping point before the investigation starts, not once it has already stalled.**


_Why:_ Investigations do not fail loudly; they absorb attention indefinitely because the next hypothesis always looks cheap from where you are standing. A stopping point agreed in advance converts a stall into a decision — hand off, ship a workaround, or accept the unknown — and all three are better than the fourth option, which is silence.
